description: A React component for a calendar page with views for month, week, and agenda, including modals for creating meetings and reminders, and event detail/editing functionality.

classes.name: CalendarEvent
classes.description: Interface representing a calendar event with properties like id, title, date, type, status, and optional meeting link and instructor name.

methods.name: fetchEvents
methods.description: Fetches calendar events from API and updates state.

methods.name: handleUpdateEvent
methods.description: Handles updating an event or assessment via API and refreshes event list.

methods.name: handleDeleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event or assessment via API and refreshes event list.

methods.name: handleSaveMeeting
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event for a meeting or live class.

methods.name: getEventTypeIcon
methods.description: Returns icon JSX element based on event type.

methods.name: getEventTypeBadge
methods.description: Returns badge JSX element with label and background color based on event type.

methods.name: getEventChipClass
methods.description: Returns CSS class string for event type styling.

methods.name: getStatusBadge
methods.description: Returns badge JSX element indicating event status.

methods.name: navigateDate
methods.description: Navigates to previous or next month/week based on current view.

methods.name: formatDateHeader
methods.description: Formats header string for current view date range.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns array of Date objects representing days in current month, including leading nulls for empty cells.

methods.name: getEventsForDate
methods.description: Filters events occurring on a specific date.

methods.name: isToday
methods.description: Checks if a date is today.

methods.name: getSegmentIndex
methods.description: Returns index for time segment (morning, afternoon, evening) based on hour.

methods.name: getEventsForWeekCell
methods.description: Returns events for a specific day and time segment in week view.
